notes: First audit. About 300 sitemap URLs inventoried, about 50 pages read in full, browser checks in Chrome, six competitor sites benchmarked. Two first-pass findings (404 page, diagram rendering) were disproved in the browser and excluded.

rationale.coverage: Discovery, AI system design, RAG, agents, production, behavioural and final-week review present; coding round (I5) and company loops (I4) empty; no client-simulation or take-home material.
rationale.depth: 33 worked designs at up to four depths plus 22 worksheets with model answers; deepest AI casebook of any site checked.
rationale.practice: Write first, compare, self-score with rubrics and timers; no AI, peer or human feedback; no spoken practice.
rationale.grounding: No company guides, reported questions or candidate experiences.
rationale.credibility: No author, About page or update dates on most pages; Credits shows much material derived from other courses.
rationale.navigation: Same content behind 2-5 hubs, 8 nav items, 7 numbering systems, 5 URL schemes.
rationale.onboarding: Five competing start pages, three meanings of path, FDE path requires an unready module.
rationale.template: Seven layouts; final-week pages outside the site shell; reading times duplicated or inconsistent; very long case tabs.
rationale.progress: Search and local progress work; 39 Blocked badges on first visit; no filters on the casebook.
rationale.polish: No custom domain, share image, canonical, analytics, About page or feedback link; build files visible; custom 404 and mobile menu fine.
